summary: This is a Mol Labs public hypothesis card (N21) proposing an assumption-kill experiment to test whether nicotine retains residual working memory (WM) / attention phenotype (≥50% of nicotine-alone) under a mecamylamine or nAChR occupancy-matched condition that abolishes nAChR-class WM rescue. The document is a research discussion (not an executed experiment), cataloguing prior art (necessity literature) and identifying a critical gap: no published head-to-head study has scored residual nicotine WM/attention under a condition that abolishes nAChR-class WM rescue on the same panel. The project is at TRL 1 — concept/hypothesis stage with no experimental data generated.

content_blocks.title: Hypothesis / Claim (N21)
content_blocks.content: On a pre-registered acute/subacute working memory / attention panel with an nAChR-class positive WM-rescue arm, a mecamylamine or nAChR occupancy-matched condition that abolishes nAChR-class WM rescue, and a nicotine arm: under the same condition that abolishes nAChR-class WM rescue, nicotine retains residual working memory / attention phenotype ≥50% of nicotine-alone (WM / attention units as pre-specified; α/N pre-specified). This is framed as an 'assumption-kill / nachr-insufficiency' test. Status: NOT_RUN (no experimental data generated).

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale and Gap Identification
content_blocks.content: Nicotine WM/attention phenotypes are commonly framed as nAChR-necessary. Levin (PMID 11224184) showed concurrent mecamylamine eliminates chronic nicotine radial-arm WM improvement (necessity, not residual). Sacco (PMID 15939842) showed mecamylamine blocks smoking-reinstatement VSWM/CPT enhancement in schizophrenia (human necessity, inverse of residual). No published head-to-head study has scored residual nicotine WM/attention under a mecamylamine/nAChR-matched condition that abolishes nAChR-class WM rescue on the same panel. The key gap: necessity ≠ residual; rescue-of-mec-block ≠ residual-under-abolish; reference-vs-WM dissociation ≠ WM-class abolish.

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: nAChR-insufficiency assumption-kill: nicotine moves rodent/human WM/attention phenotypes, and mecamylamine/nAChR antagonism can abolish nAChR-class WM rescue. Preferred design: same-panel acute/subacute WM/attention lock (Levin-class rodent radial-arm maze or Sacco-class human VSWM/CPT) with nAChR-class positive WM rescue ± mecamylamine or named nAChR occupancy-matched abolish condition vs nicotine ± same condition. Optional cell/SPR/occupancy overlay only after abolish×residual locks. Competing caveats: abolish condition fails to kill nAChR-class WM rescue / nicotine-alone null / underpowered strata / assay-identity mismatch.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary
content_blocks.content:
Four prior art references identified:
1. PMID 11224184 (Levin, Behav Pharmacol 1993): Chronic nicotine improves radial-arm maze WM; improvement eliminated by concurrent mecamylamine. Classification: NECESSITY (inverse of residual); not residual-under-abolish H2H.
2. PMID 15939842 (Sacco, Arch Gen Psychiatry 2005): Smoking reinstatement reverses abstinence-induced VSWM/CPT impairment in schizophrenia; enhancement blocked by mecamylamine. Classification: Human NECESSITY nAChR for smoking-related WM/attention rescue; inverse of residual.
3. PMID 12191812 (Behav Brain Res 2002): Post-training nicotine radial-arm maze — mecamylamine blocks nicotine reference-memory enhancement but NOT working-memory enhancement. Classification: WM residual-dissociation under mecamylamine that abolishes reference rescue; WM-class rescue was NOT abolished, so ≠ full residual-under-WM-abolish H2H.
4. PMID 11927157 (Levin, Neuroscience 2002): Ventral hippocampal mecamylamine/DHβE/MLA impair radial-arm maze WM. Classification: Hippocampal α7/α4β2 WM necessity/phenotype prior; no systemic residual-positive nicotine under abolish of nicotine WM rescue.

content_blocks.title: Prediction Variables Table
content_blocks.content:
Six prediction variables defined:
1. Levin_chronic_nicotine_mecamylamine_WM_necessity — LITERATURE — Rat radial-arm maze; chronic nicotine ± concurrent mecamylamine — Result: NECESSITY inverse of residual (PMID 11224184).
2. Sacco_smoking_mecamylamine_VSWM_CPT_necessity — LITERATURE — Human smokers with schizophrenia; VSWM + CPT ± mecamylamine — Result: Human NECESSITY inverse of residual (PMID 15939842).
3. radial_arm_mec_blocks_reference_not_WM_dissociation — LITERATURE — Rat 8-arm radial maze; post-training nicotine ± mecamylamine — Result: Residual-dissociation; WM-class not abolished (PMID 12191812).
4. Levin_hippocampal_alpha7_alpha4beta2_WM_necessity — LITERATURE — Rat radial-arm maze; ventral hippocampal nAChR antagonist infusions — Result: Phenotype/necessity prior; no systemic residual-positive (PMID 11927157).
5. matched_residual_nicotine_under_nAChR_block_abolishing_WM_class_H2H — UNKNOWN — Same acute/subacute WM/attention panel with nAChR-class positive WM rescue ± mecamylamine or nAChR occupancy-matched abolish + nicotine ± same condition — Result: UNKNOWN; residual-under-WM-abolish H2H = 0; missing_search.
6. residual_nicotine_phenotype_ge_50pct_of_alone_when_nAChR_class_abolished — PREDICTION — Pre-registered acute/subacute WM/attention panel; nAChR-class arm must show abolished WM rescue; nicotine arm scored for residual phenotype vs nicotine-alone — Threshold: ≥50% of nicotine-alone (WM/attention units as pre-specified); α/N pre-specified.
7. competing_abolish_fail_or_nicotine_null_or_underpowered_inconclusive — PREDICTION — Same design; competing outcomes if abolish fails, nicotine-alone null, underpowered, or assay-identity mismatch — Outcome: inconclusive_if ≠ refute_if.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. N1–N20 do not prove N21 — N15 is residual modafinil PVT under DAT-matched block; N16 is plasma-Cr↑ without ³¹P PCr; N17 is Hericium residual under NGF/TrkA block; N18 is L-theanine residual under caffeine-matched adenosine; N19 is Rhodiola residual under HPA/cortisol-matched challenge; N20 is Bacopa residual under donepezil/AChE occupancy match.
2. Necessity ≠ residual — Levin 11224184 and Sacco 15939842 show concurrent mecamylamine eliminates/blocks nicotine or smoking-related WM rescue (inverse of residual claim). 12191812 residual-dissociation (WM survives mec that blocks reference) ≠ residual under abolish of WM-class rescue.
3. Necessity/dissociation priors lack nachr-insufficiency residual-under-WM-abolish arms; lock same-panel acute/subacute WM/attention with nAChR-class positive WM rescue ± mecamylamine or nAChR occupancy-matched challenge vs nicotine ± same condition; no dosing; NOT MB/MAOI.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria and Execution Status
content_blocks.content:
Refute if: On the pre-registered acute/subacute WM/attention panel, under mecamylamine or nAChR occupancy-matched condition that abolishes nAChR-class WM rescue, residual nicotine WM/attention phenotype falls below 50% of nicotine-alone — so nAChR-class sufficiency for nicotine phenotype survives and nachr-insufficiency fails — when abolish-gate, nicotine-alone comparator, and power/assay artifacts are ruled out.
Execution status: NOT_RUN. FTO status: UNKNOWN. Kill cost tier: 2. Time to refute: 6 weeks. IP class: nachr-insufficiency. Vault hold: no. Status label: NEGATIVE (polarity: negative). Related prior: N15–N20 (all distinct from N21).

key_findings: Hypothesis N21 is at TRL 1 — pure concept/discussion stage; execution_status=NOT_RUN, no experimental data generated.

Core claim: nicotine retains residual WM/attention phenotype ≥50% of nicotine-alone under mecamylamine or nAChR occupancy-matched condition that abolishes nAChR-class WM rescue — currently UNKNOWN with no published H2H data.
Levin (PMID 11224184): chronic nicotine improves radial-arm maze WM; concurrent mecamylamine eliminates improvement — establishes NECESSITY (inverse of residual), not residual-under-abolish.
Sacco (PMID 15939842): smoking reinstatement reverses abstinence-induced VSWM/CPT impairment in schizophrenia; mecamylamine blocks enhancement — human NECESSITY, inverse of residual.

PMID 12191812: mecamylamine blocks nicotine reference-memory enhancement but NOT WM enhancement (residual-dissociation), but WM-class rescue was not abolished, so does not constitute full residual-under-WM-abolish H2H.
PMID 11927157: ventral hippocampal nAChR antagonism impairs WM — phenotype/necessity prior only; no systemic residual-positive nicotine under abolish of nicotine WM rescue.
Critical gap: matched residual-nicotine under mecamylamine/nAChR block that abolishes nAChR-class WM rescue H2H = 0 published studies found (soft-complete Q_resid/Q_resid_tight NON-MATCH).
Necessity ≠ residual is the central logical distinction: prior art proves necessity but cannot be interpreted as evidence for or against residual phenotype under abolish condition.

Proposed assay design: same-panel acute/subacute WM/attention (Levin-class rodent radial-arm maze or Sacco-class human VSWM/CPT) with nAChR-class positive WM rescue arm ± mecamylamine or nAChR occupancy-matched abolish condition vs nicotine ± same condition.
Kill cost tier 2; estimated time to refute: 6 weeks; IP class: nachr-insufficiency; NOT MB/MAOI; ip_class=none not to be burned.
